serverLogs.title: Server logs
serverLogs.body: When you access this application, the server processes technical data such as IP address, date and time, requested URL and browser user agent to deliver the page and protect against abuse (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Request logs are deleted automatically after a short period (5 days by default).

accounts.title: User accounts
accounts.body: Accounts are created by administrators for staff. We store email address, username, first and last name, an optional avatar, your preferred language and the assigned role to provide the service (Art. 6(1)(b) GDPR). Data is kept while the account exists; you can delete your account yourself at any time.

ratings.title: Ratings and comments
ratings.body: Ratings, difficulty votes and comments on routes can be submitted without an account and are stored without name or IP address. Comments are publicly visible and may be moderated.

reports.title: Content reports
reports.body: If you report content, we process your name, email address, the report reason and your explanation to handle the report and inform you about the decision (Art. 6(1)(c) GDPR in conjunction with Art. 16 DSA). Reports are kept as long as needed for documentation.

auditLog.title: Audit log
auditLog.body: Changes, logins and failed login attempts by staff are logged with user, action and IP address to ensure security and traceability (Art. 6(1)(f) GDPR). Entries are deleted automatically after {auditDays} days.

captcha.title: Spam protection
captcha.body: Some forms use a self-hosted proof-of-work check that runs in your browser. No data is sent to third parties and no tracking cookies are set.

thirdParties.title: No tracking, no third parties
thirdParties.body: This application does not use analytics, advertising or social media plugins and loads no resources from third-party servers. All data is processed on our own server. Data is not transferred to third countries.

storage.title: Cookies and local storage
storage.body: We only store information on your device that is strictly necessary to provide the service you requested (§ 25(2) TDDDG). Therefore no consent is required. The complete list:

rights.title: Your rights
rights.body: Under the GDPR you have the following rights regarding your personal data:

items.restriction: Right to restriction of processing (Art. 18 GDPR)
items.withdrawal: Right to withdraw consent at any time (Art. 7(3) GDPR)

rights.complaint: You also have the right to lodge a complaint with a data protection supervisory authority (Art. 77 GDPR).
